notes.notes:
We are delighted to announce that we will be providing the instrumental version of our game's highly acclaimed theme song for you to download and use for free.

This music is a part of our game, and by offering this instrumental version, we aim to enable you to incorporate it into your creations, whether it be cover songs, remixes, or other forms of derivative works.

Please note that if you plan to use this music for derivative works, kindly attribute the source of the song when publishing. This will help protect copyright and also let others know where the music comes from.

We look forward to seeing how you use this music in your creations and anticipate your outstanding work!

Happy creating!

Noisy Fish Studio

notes.title: FAQ when Gameplay
notes.notes:
Hey, players! Since the game release yesterday, we received many of your questions. We quickly prepared an FAQ for the gameplay, which might be helpful for your journey of voice director!

1	 How to unlock the new favorability level?
	After triggering certain key plots, the relationship between Aki and the characters will rise to a new stage, and the new one will also be unlocked.
	
2	Where to trigger the key plot?
	When the time and favorability reach the standard, the key plot may not only appear on the map, but also be triggered when recording the character's exclusive radio drama. In addition, a small part of the plots are triggered during rest and online learning.
	
3	How to get a new specialty (voice tune)?
	Voice actors' specialties can be unlocked as the key scenarios progress.
	
4	Why is there an X on the lock?
        If the key plot is not triggered before the key time point, you can no longer pursue the character, and the lock for raising the favorability level will be marked with an X. Be sure to complete the character's exclusive radio drama as soon as possible! In addition, some key plots are triggered during online learning courses and rest in the early stage.
	
5	Will the choice affect the ending directly?
        Only the last 2 choices will directly affect the direction of the plot, including the choice of public security incidents in May, and the choice of Aki to take whom away during the self-media event in September. (If the conditions are not met, the relevant options of the character will not appear) Most choices will only affect the increase in favorability.
	
6	Being rejected when invited? 
        The locations that the characters like are unlocked according to the favorability. Initially, only 2 places can be invited. As the favorability level rises to higher stages, more places can be invited. For places that are not liked and places that are not yet open due to insufficient favorability level, the character's reply when invited is different. If the selected character doesn't like it at all, Aki will smartly discover and mutter to himself. 
        After the simulated dating plot, characters who meet the threshold of favorability and plot progress will send a message to inform the invitation location. Invite the object you want to pursue as soon as possible when you are free!
	
7	Other tips:
	The 4 main drama must be recorded within the time limit in order to continue the game smoothly.
        Some plots of Yuki will only appear after the second week.

notes.title: Delayed Release Announcement
notes.notes:
Dear all players,

This is the official team of "Voice Love on Air."

Since the release of the first PV on Valentine's Day, followed by the DEMO at the end of February, up until this time nearing White Day, "Voice Love on Air" has received much anticipation and support from friends who are interested in our game. We have earnestly listened to everyone's valuable suggestions.

We sincerely appreciate all of you for giving us so much confidence to create this niche genre game. We have made thorough preparations, but we have encountered some issues during Valve's review process, and we are doing our best to solve them.

Therefore, we regret to inform everyone that the game will need to be postponed. The new release date will be announced soon.

On White Day, we will present the Lyrics MV of the game's full version theme song as a gift to everyone. Thank you for your anticipation and support, and please continue to stay tuned to "Voice Love on Air" by Softstar Entertainment.
